limitations: This is a 45 s validation protocol, not a new full-cycle catalogue task.
Closure includes the actuator approach and takes longer than the unchanged original 15 s atomic limit.
The final insertion assessment retains its original 15 s timing result; sequence_success checks actual geometry/stability and the separate declared 45 s protocol.
Two native expert seeds are qualified; no native no-action control or ten-seed chain campaign was run.
Rotor drive, speed/RCF programme, balance checks, start/stop, braking and lid safety interlocks remain unimplemented.
The original standalone validator is archived byte-for-byte in isaac_centrifuge_chain_validator.py; it is separate from the catalogue task API.
The historical standalone lid golden fixture still differs by 2.858623e-5 in qpos before and after the refactor.
